title: Recursive CLIP: Vision-Language Distillation with Looped Transformer Blocks
abstract: arXiv:2610.34563v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Contrastive vision-language models such as CLIP typically rely on independently parameterized transformer blocks across depth. We investigate the extent to which these blocks can instead be reused recurrently while preserving the transferable capabilities of CLIP. We study recursive transformer backbones in which a small set of $N$ transformer blocks is applied $M$ times per forward pass. By holding $N \cdot M$ fixed to the depth of a standard ViT-B, our models preserve computational depth while progressively increasing parameter sharing. We consider two recursive CLIP model families: rCLIP, where only the vision encoder is recursive, and r$^2$CLIP, where recurrence is also introduced in the text encoder. We study these models under both direct contrastive training and through knowledge distillation from a strong ViT-B/16 teacher pretrained on DFN-2B, using the substantially smaller CC3M and CC12M datasets. translated_abstract: 对比式视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）通常在深度方向上依赖独立参数化的Transformer块。我们研究了这些块在多大程度上可以被循环复用，同时保持CLIP的可迁移能力。我们研究了递归Transformer骨干网络，其中一小组N个Transformer块在前向传播中被应用M次。通过将N·M固定为标准ViT-B的深度，我们的模型在逐步增加参数共享的同时保持了计算深度。我们考虑了两个递归CLIP模型家族：rCLIP（仅视觉编码器是递归的）和r²CLIP（文本编码器也引入了递归）。我们在两种设置下研究这些模型：直接对比训练，以及从在DFN-2B上预训练的强大ViT-B/16教师模型进行知识蒸馏，并使用规模小得多的CC3M和CC12M数据集。我们评估了所得模型
tldr: 该论文提出递归CLIP模型家族（rCLIP和r²CLIP），通过循环复用少量Transformer块来大幅减少参数量并保持计算深度，结合知识蒸馏技术在小规模数据集上实现了高效的视觉-语言模型训练。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes recursive CLIP model families (rCLIP and r²CLIP) that reduce parameters by recursively reusing a small set of transformer blocks while preserving computational depth, enabling efficient vision-language training with knowledge distillation on small-scale datasets.
